cft_lead: A template says how to check a stack. JGates applies the ones from the catalog and from your project according to what it finds in the components.
cft_none_project: No project template yet. Create one for a stack the catalog does not cover.
cft_details_aria: See the details of the template {name}
cft_required_reason: Required: it is always applied, and turning it off would leave the plan without this base.
cft_governed_reason: Governed mode: the templates are fixed by the policy {policy} and do not change here.
cft_created: Template {id} created in {folder} and registered in jgates.yml.
cft_order_lead: From weakest to strongest: what comes later replaces what comes before.
cft_create_lead: Creates a file in {folder} from the model: it extends base, matches a stack and declares one check by generic command.
cft_create_id_help: Lowercase letters, numbers, dot, hyphen and underscore. Example: go-service.
cft_create_match_help: Separate with commas. With no language or framework, the template only applies when someone requests it.
cft_create_command_help: Example: go test ./... . The command becomes a vector, never a shell line.
cft_create_evidence_help: The exit code alone proves little: it never covers security, architecture or tests by itself.
cft_d_chain_lead: From the ancestor to the template: each one shows what it defines. The badge marks the field that replaces an ancestor's.
